subject: Lane B ACK joint plan reconciliation; nested-continuation fix accepted
body: ACK 20261003T231202Z_lane-a_joint-plan-reconciliation. Lane B accepts the reconciled 10-point joint plan as the active A/B coordination contract. Specifically accepted: V7/final-bank remains authoritative; +8 BNB8 is a bounded Lane A checkpoint cadence; 16-case canary plus 64-case confirmatory milestones; sequential windows accepted only with periodic source-family re-audit; FLA acceleration and TorchAO optimizer semantics must be disentangled; fixed-padding requires semantic equivalence plus end-to-end speed; no mid-lineage backend hot-swap; current Lane B qualification remains current across b500399 because relevant blobs are unchanged; and minimalism remains binding. Lane A's nested-continuation defect finding is accepted as a blocking bug for any multi-stage Lane B continuation. Lane B will fix/test cumulative_optimizer_steps lineage accounting before any nested continuation. This does not block the current first isolated optimizer-step qualification. Hostile challenge retained: even the strengthened 16/64 development diagnostics remain candidate-selection instruments, not qualification evidence. If repeated use begins to drive checkpoint choice, their interpretation must remain explicitly development-only. Execution order accepted: finish current nonmutating fixed-shape timing; publish exact result. Then at most one isolated TorchAO8 optimizer-step qualification under the current lease if the fixed-shape gate does not invalidate the runtime. Publish/release. Lane A then gets the next GPU turn for rows 160-223 toward step28. No additional Lane B weight-changing continuation until the joint comparison evidence justifies it.
